title: SrcBox voice vocabulary pack
description: The words a spoken sentence is read with. A pack replaces every section it carries and leaves the sections it omits to the built-in tables, so a pack may be a whole vocabulary or a small correction.

schema.description: Format version. The app refuses a pack that names another one.

lang.description: The language this vocabulary is written for, for example zh-CN.

version.description: Compared as dotted numbers against the built-in version to decide whether an update is worth offering.

updated.description: Free text, shown in the settings window.

notes.description: Free text, shown in the settings window.

phrases.description: Tested in this order; the first match wins, so a narrow phrasing has to come before a broad one.

prepositions.description: Filler between the verb and its target.

noiseWords.description: Words dropped before the rest of a sentence is treated as a channel or programme name.

hotwords.description: Channel and programme names the recogniser should be biased towards. Only recognisers that support a word list use them.

name.description: Unique within a pack; reported back as the rule that matched.

pattern.description: A .NET regular expression, matched against the sentence with the punctuation and the spaces removed. It is compiled with a 50 ms timeout.

numberGroup.description: Name of the group holding a number to read, such as num.

relativeGroup.description: Name of the group holding a relative change, such as louder or quieter.

arg.description: Fixed argument for a phrasing that carries none, such as -1 for the next channel.

timeWords.description: Every list is optional; a list that is left out keeps the built-in words.

parts.description: Order is precedence: the first part whose word appears wins, so 凌晨 has to come before 早上.
